item.title: Sustainable Materials and Innovation for a Greener Future
item.description:
Embracing Nature and Innovation for a Sustainable Tomorrow
#

AceGreen Eco-Material Technology Co., Ltd. is dedicated to advancing eco-friendly materials and sustainable solutions. With a strong foundation in research and development, our journey began in 1994 when our parent company, Acelon, invested in Lyocell R&D. In 2011, AceGreen was established in Ershui Township, Changhua County, focusing on the production of cellulose filament products. Today, we are recognized among the global leaders in cellulose production, continuously striving to build greener supply chains and promote innovative green products worldwide.

item.title: Sustainable Innovation in Cellulose Materials
item.description:
Sustainable Innovation in Cellulose Materials
#

Founded on a vision of environmental responsibility and technological advancement, AceGreen Eco-Material Technology Co., Ltd. has established itself as a key player in the global cellulose industry. Our journey began in 1994, when our parent company, Acelon, initiated research and development in Lyocell fibers. Building on this foundation, AceGreen was officially established in 2011 in Ershui Township, Changhua County, Taiwan, with a primary focus on producing high-quality cellulose filament products.

item.title: Sustainable Materials and Responsible Innovation
item.description:
Commitment to a Greener Future: Our Philosophy
#

At AceGreen, our guiding principle is rooted in the belief that true progress comes from harmonizing innovation with environmental responsibility. We are dedicated to fostering a green lifestyle and prioritize sustainability at every stage of our operations, guided by our core approach: Nature to Nature.

item.title: Highlights from TexWorld Paris 2024 and Our Commitment to Collaboration
item.description:
TexWorld Paris 2024: Connecting the Global Fashion Industry
#

Twice a year, TexWorld Paris brings together over a thousand exhibitors from across the fashion industry, creating a dynamic sourcing platform for professional buyers worldwide. The event showcases a broad spectrum of products, ranging from essential basics to the most innovative and high-quality materials.

item.title: Recent Developments and Sustainability Initiatives in Eco-Materials
item.description:
Recent Developments and Sustainability Initiatives in Eco-Materials
#

Latest News Highlights
#

Bioworks Establishes First Overseas Office in Taiwan
#

Bioworks, Developer of the Plant-Based Next-Generation Synthetic Fiber PlaX, Establishes First Overseas Office in Taiwan
PlaX, developed through Bioworks’ proprietary research and development, is a next-generation synthetic fiber made from plants. This innovative material serves as an alternative to petroleum-based synthetic fibers, supporting the transition to more sustainable textile solutions. (2025/05/20)

Embracing Nature to Nature: Our Commitment to Sustainable Materials
#

At AceGreen Eco-Material Technology, we are dedicated to advancing the use of sustainable materials and innovative processes. Our philosophy, “Nature to Nature,” reflects our determination to create products that respect and preserve the environment while meeting the needs of modern industries.
